game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Mushroom Market Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market, a forest mushroom market: the fairy gardener must handle giant beetles while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Mushroom Market: a forest mushroom market
core_gameplay_loop: In Mushroom Market, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the waterfall gate using at most 13 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
win_condition: The waterfall gate reached with actions_used <= 13.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 13 before the waterfall gate is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 7 (applied tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
